title: Power Book IV: Force's Joseph Sikora & Deon Taylor Say Force's Season Two Finale Is A Must See
htmlContent:
Deon Taylor and Joseph Sikora talked about the new movie ‘Fear,’ an American horror film, an independently funded project. The film also features Andrew Bachelor, Annie Ilonzeh, Ruby Modine, Iddo Goldberg, Terrence Jenkins, and Jessica Allain. Both Sikora and Taylor were on Instagram Live with Hollywood Unlocked.

Towards the end of the interview, both individuals start talking about the upcoming season two of Power Book IV: Force.

"So, Power is coming man and when I tell you Power is coming in a real way. It is coming for real man . I was there to shoot the finale and I'm going to tell y'all, y'all ain't never seen a finale like this, said Taylor.

"Listen to what I'm telling you; you ain't never seen a finale like this. It is so good; shout to 50 [Cent], Kris Lofton, Issac Keys the whole team over there. But when y'all season of Power, trust me, you are going to say we back. We're back for real; it's crazy."

Sikora added, "Yeah, Power is back, Book Four, It is like the original but it set in Chicago. Season two we got it right, I can't wait for everybody to see this again. Deon massacred that finale! People are going to love it."

Last month, Sikora jumped on IG Live & shared, that Starz had not announced the release date for Force Season two, but he had it on good authority that could make it's debut in May of 2023.
